exposure: Antibiotic treatment for respiratory tract infections
Maternal antibiotic use in the 80 weeks after pregnancy
Maternal antibiotic use in the 80 weeks before pregnancy
Antibiotic treatment for other types of infections
Maternal use of antibiotics during pregnancy
cohort: 910,301 children born in Denmark between 1997 and 2010
finding: While a dose-related association was found between maternal antibiotic use and risk of asthma in offspring, this association was independent of the timing of antibiotic use in relation to pregnancy, suggesting maternal antibiotic use may be a surrogate marker for a mother's general propensity for infections.
mod_finding: This study adjusted for mode of delivery, but did not examine its association with the main outcomes.
